battle.name: 旭烈兀西征
battle.theater: 伊朗高原阿拉穆特山谷
battle.brief: 1256年11月，旭烈兀分兵翻越阿拉穆特山脈合圍梅蒙迪茲，投石機連日砲擊後逼降伊瑪目魯克努丁·庫爾沙，魯斯巴河谷四十餘堡奉令開城，阿拉穆特守將穆巴里茲亦依令出降，尼札里伊斯瑪儀派就此淪亡。攻城序列中弩手與投石機並用，弩在城頭之爭居功至要，野戰則仍以蒙古弓為主力。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰的一方是蒙古帝國。1251 年大汗蒙哥在怯綠連河大會上分派諸王的方向，把西線的攻略交給弟旭烈兀，1253 年旭烈兀率約十萬人自大漠西南行，目標是已經衰落的阿拔斯哈里發國與拒絕臣服的尼札里伊斯瑪儀派。蒙古方面的組成是大汗直屬的西征軍、別兒哥與拜都分管的西部兀魯思軍隊、察合台與窩闊台兩支後軍，以及工匠、攻城器匠與漢軍炮手組成的技術隊；旭烈兀自任統帥，怯的不花與拜都分領中軍與右翼，軍力核心是能連續騎射的草原騎兵，攻城所需的重裝則靠隨軍的投石機隊與工匠營。另一方是三支互不相同的軍隊：巴格達的阿拔斯哈里發，哈里發穆斯台爾綏姆，握有哈里發本人的禁軍、土耳其奴兵，以及摩蘇爾總督宋古爾·納西里所部號稱「城堡之子」的軍鎮；山中的尼札里伊斯瑪儀派，末代伊瑪目魯克努丁·庫爾沙坐鎮阿拉穆特與梅蒙迪茲，魯斯巴河谷內散布數十座石造堡壘，另有小股遊騎往來；還有塞柱國、喬治亞王國等被蒙古軍強行徵發人丁與糧秣的附庸地區。整體而言，這是一場帝國層級的西進：草原騎兵在速度與投射量上壓倒對手，把中東的抵抗壓縮到山地城堡與美索不達米亞的城牆上，最終在 1258 年以哈里發本人被殺、伊斯蘭世界再無巴格達哈里發收場。
countriesEn: One side of this conflict was the Mongol Empire. At the kurultai of 1251 the Great Khan Möngke assigned directions to his princes and handed the western theatre to his brother Hülegü, who in 1253 marched out of the steppe with roughly a hundred thousand men, aimed at the declining Abbasid caliphate and at the Nizari Ismailis, who would not submit. The Mongol side was made up of the Great Khan's own expeditionary army, the western hosts of the steppe under Berke and Baidu, the Chagatai and Ögedei contingents, and a technical corps of engineers, siege craftsmen and Chinese gunners; Hülegü commanded in person, Kitbuqa and Baidu led the centre and the right wing, the core of the force was steppe cavalry able to shoot repeatedly from the saddle, and the heavy material for sieges travelled with the mangonel teams and the craft camp. The other side was three quite separate armies: the Abbasid caliph at Baghdad, al-Musta'sim, with the caliphal household troops, Turkish ghulams, and the Mosul governor Sunqur al-Nasiri's host, known to the Mongols as the Sons of the Castle; the Nizari Ismailis in the mountains, with the last Imam Rukn al-Din Khurshah at Alamut and Maymun-Diz, several dozen stone fortresses scattered along the Rusbar valley and a few bands of mobile horsemen; and client regions such as the Seljuks of Rum and the Kingdom of Georgia, whose men and grain the Mongols simply requisitioned as they passed. In the end this was an imperial westward drive: steppe cavalry, with their speed and volume of fire, compressed the resistance of the Middle East down into mountain fortresses and the walls of Mesopotamia, and it closed in 1258 with the death of the caliph himself and the end of any Baghdad caliphate in the Islamic world.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的有三組人物。蒙古方面：大汗蒙哥在 1251 年的怯綠連河大會上劃定旭烈兀西進的方向，旭烈兀自 1253 年出發，兩度致書西方君主，最後在波斯建立伊利汗國；其旗下大將怯的不花統領中軍，攻城與野戰皆用為先鋒，拜都是西方草原的元帥之一，與別兒哥爭奪西線主導權，別兒哥在旭烈兀兵鋒西指的同時抽身北還，兩人的分合牽動整個西征方略。東方方面，哈里發穆斯台爾綏姆於 1252 年即位，起初與蒙古議和，1255 年之後拒絕再納貢，1258 年 2 月在巴格達被殺，朝廷大權隨之瓦解。伊斯瑪儀派方面，末代伊瑪目魯克努丁·庫爾沙在梅蒙迪茲被困後出降，遣使四處下令城堡投降；阿拉穆特的守將穆卡達姆·丁·穆罕默德·穆巴里茲據城不降，直到聽見伊瑪目已於 1256 年 12 月投降的命令才隨之出降。伊拉克邊境上，摩蘇爾的阿塔貝格蘇聰·納西里拒絕歸降，被旭烈兀於 1259 年處死。記錄這段歷史的是史官艾塔·馬利克·賈兀兒（志費尼），他隨軍擔任書記官，奉旭烈兀之命把勸降詔書送入梅蒙迪茲，事後寫成《世界史》，是本役最核心的第一手史料。
peopleEn: Three groups of men shaped the course of this war. On the Mongol side, the Great Khan Möngke fixed the direction of Hülegü's advance at the kurultai of 1251; Hülegü rode out in 1253, addressed letters twice to the rulers of the west, and in the end founded the Ilkhanate in Persia. Under him the general Kitbuqa commanded the centre and served as spearhead in both siege and field, while Baidu was one of the marshals of the western steppe and rivalled Berke for overall control of the western front; Berke withdrew northward while Hülegü's spear pointed west, and the way these two men detached or closed with each other shaped the strategy of the whole expedition. In the east, the caliph al-Musta'sim succeeded to the throne in 1252 and at first came to terms with the Mongols, but after 1255 he refused further tribute; in February 1258 he was killed in Baghdad and the authority of his court collapsed with him. Among the Ismailis, the last Imam Rukn al-Din Khurshah came down from Maymun-Diz once he was surrounded and sent word ordering the castles to surrender; the commander of Alamut, Muqaddam al-Din Muhammad Mubariz, held the castle until he learned in December 1256 that the Imam had already surrendered, and then capitulated in turn. On the Iraqi frontier the Mosul atabeg Sunqur al-Nasiri refused to submit and was put to death by Hülegü in 1259. The man who recorded all this was the historian Ata-Malik Juvayni, who served as secretary on the campaign and carried Hülegü's decree for surrender into Maymun-Diz in person; he later set the whole affair down in the Tarikh-i Jahan Gusheh, the central first-hand source for this campaign.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩在十三世紀的伊朗與伊拉克並不算新物。伊斯蘭世界把弩稱為 jibāq，中亞商路早就在流通中國與費爾干納製作的弩；蒙古人西征把草原的弓馬技術與東亞的攻城器械合在一起，弩在大軍中自成一隊專門的射手。攻城時它與投石機同為壓制城頭的手段：弩的單支重箭能穿甲、射程遠勝火把，因此常被排在城牆正面與缺口兩側，逼守軍躲在垛口後方待機。卡面那句「城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱」正好概括它在 1256 年前前後後的位置——在梅蒙迪茲與阿拉穆特這樣的山城，蒙古軍先用配重式投石機以浸油標槍與石彈擾亂守軍，再以弩手與弓箭手交替射擊；一旦進入敘利亞、伊拉克的平原野戰，蒙古騎兵靠的是能一次拉開的蒙古弓與複合反曲弓，弩的裝填遲緩便成了累贅，只留給守營、護帳與追擊潰兵之用。與弩同列的還有：配重式投石機與各類攻城器械，攻城時由工匠隊操作；載人雲梯與活動塔架；壕道用的鎬鏟、木槌與支木；1258 年渡過底格里斯河所用的浮橋與舟筏；以及大量備用弓弦、箭袋與箭鏃。馬匹是全軍真正的縱深，一匹戰馬的草料與飲水直接決定行軍速度。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card was no novelty in thirteenth-century Iran and Iraq. The Islamic world called the crossbow jibaq, and the Central Asian trade routes had long carried crossbows made in China and Ferghana; the Mongols, marching west, fused the steppe tradition of bow and horse with the siege technology of East Asia, and the crossbow formed its own body of shooters within the army. In siege it stood alongside the mangonel as a means of silencing the parapet: a single heavy bolt could pierce armour and outrange a torch, so crossbowmen were posted opposite the face of the wall and beside the breaches, forcing the defenders to wait behind their merlons. The line on the card, that on a wall it is more reliable than the long bow and in the open field more fragile, describes its place around 1256 exactly. Against such strongholds as Maymun-Diz and Alamut the Mongols first disorganised the garrison with counterweight mangonels throwing stone and javelins dipped in burning pitch, and then worked crossbowmen and archers in alternation; once the campaigning moved onto the plains of Syria and Iraq, the Mongol horsemen relied on the Mongolian bow and the composite recurved bow that could be drawn in one pull, and the slow reload of the crossbow became a liability, leaving it for camp defence, escort duty and the pursuit of routed troops. Alongside the crossbow in the train came counterweight mangonels and other siege engines worked by the craft corps, boarding ladders and movable siege towers, picks, mallets and props for sapping tunnels, the pontoons and rafts used to cross the Tigris in 1258, and large stocks of spare bowstrings, quivers and arrowheads. Horses were the true depth of the army: the fodder and water of a single war horse set the pace of the march.
tactics: 旭烈兀的西征不是一場會戰，而是一串以工程、機動與心理為主的圍城與迫降。行軍上，蒙古軍分數路縱隊前進，部隊以就地取糧維持自己，抵達一地即散開徵收糧秣，因此能連續推進而不必維持長距離的糧車線。1256 年 11 月 8 日，旭烈兀的先鋒翻過泰利甘河谷、越過阿拉穆特山脈，出人意料地出現在梅蒙迪茲山下完成合圍，靠的就是這種速度與保密。攻城序列是固定的：先以配重式投石機連續三日砲擊，再於第四日發動強攻；強攻被守軍擲石與火油擊退之後，蒙古人改在四面加設更重的攻城機，擲射浸油標槍，一舉封住城頭；同時把隊伍分成合圍大軍與預備隊，斷絕城內消息與糧道。19 日伊瑪目庫爾沙帶著侍從下山投降，魯斯巴河谷約四十座城堡隨之奉令開城；阿拉穆特由拜拉海率大軍圍困，旭烈兀自率主力轉攻蘭姆薩爾，最後守將穆巴里茲聽從伊瑪目已降的命令開城。城破之後是拆毀：賈兀兒記載蒙古人必須先放火燒屋，再逐段拆毀抹灰的城牆與包鉛的城垛。往西的攻法同樣工程先行：1258 年巴格達之戰，蒙古人在底格里斯河上築壩改道、以舟筏搭成浮橋，再用投石機、塔架與密集的弩手步步逼近城牆，直到哈里發出城。野戰則是另一套：1260 年艾因賈魯特，馬木魯克以佯退引誘蒙古軍追擊再回身死鬥，蒙古軍拉開的戰線未能及時合攏，怯的不花的左翼與主力失聯，戰局就此翻轉。
tacticsEn: Hülegü's western expedition was not a single battle but a chain of sieges and forced surrenders fought with engineering, mobility and pressure on the enemy's nerve. On the march the Mongol army advanced in several columns, each corps subsisting on what it took from the country, scattering to gather grain and fodder on arrival, so that it could move on continuously without maintaining a long wagon supply line. On 8 November 1256 the vanguard of Hülegü crossed the Taleqan valley and came over the Alamut range to appear unexpectedly at the foot of Maymun-Diz and complete the encirclement, and it was speed and concealment that did it. The siege order was fixed: three days of bombardment by counterweight mangonels, then a general assault on the fourth day; when that assault was thrown back by stones and fire poured from above, the Mongols brought up heavier engines on all sides, hurling javelins dipped in burning pitch and closing off the parapet, while they split the army between the ring of besiegers and the reserve, cutting the town's messages and its supply. On the 19th the Imam Khurshah came down the mountain with his entourage and surrendered, and some forty castles in the Rusbar valley opened their gates on his command; Alamut was invested by a large force under Balaghai while Hülegü took the main body against Lambsar, and at last the commander Mubariz opened the gate in obedience to the Imam's already-given surrender. After the fall came the demolition: Juvayni records that the Mongols had to set fire to the buildings and then break down the plastered walls and lead-covered ramparts piece by piece. Further west the method was equally engineering-led: in the siege of Baghdad in 1258 the Mongols dammed and diverted the Tigris, bridged it with a pontoon of boats, and then brought the walls down step by step with mangonels, towers and masses of crossbowmen, until the caliph came out of his city. Open-field battle worked differently: at Ain Jalut in 1260 the Mamluks feigned flight to draw the Mongols after them and then turned to fight, the Mongol line could not close in time, Kitbuqa's left flank lost contact with the centre, and the battle turned.
data: 關於兵力與時間，現存說法多有出入，只能取其大略。蒙哥在 1251 年撥給旭烈兀的兵員，漢文史料記為十萬人，波斯與阿拉伯史料則連工匠、輔助部隊一併計入，說法可達十五萬乃至二十萬；蒙古方面 1254 年致教宗英諾森四世的信中，自稱在波斯已折損的伊斯瑪儀派騎兵以萬計，這類數字出自蒙古方面的宣傳，應作誇大來看。梅蒙迪茲一役的時間點是清楚的：1256 年 11 月 8 日合圍，11 月 19 日伊瑪目出降，全程約十一天，其間投石機試射三日、第四日強攻失利；魯斯巴河谷約四十座城堡在投降令下陸續開城。阿拉穆特的守軍規模不大，守將穆巴里茲於 1256 年 12 月出降，部分史料把正式投降記在 1257 年 1 月；而 1257 年至 1258 年蒙古方面的戰報與遠方教宗得到的消息仍混在一起，說明情報傳遞至少落後數月。距離也值得一記：阿拉穆特到巴格達約六百公里，蒙古軍在 1257 年從呼羅珊南下時，靠的是連續的騎行推進而非分段設防；到了 1260 年春，旭烈兀自報的西征軍總數仍是「數十萬」的量級，說法本身卻已無法核對。
dataEn: On numbers and dates the surviving accounts disagree, and only the broad picture can be trusted. The troops Möngke assigned to Hülegü in 1251 are recorded in the Chinese sources as a hundred thousand men; the Persian and Arabic accounts fold in craftsmen and auxiliaries and give figures of a hundred and fifty thousand or even two hundred thousand. In the letter of 1254 to Pope Innocent IV the Mongols claimed to have destroyed Ismaili cavalry in Persia by the tens of thousands; such figures come from Mongol propaganda and should be treated as inflated. The chronology of Maymun-Diz is firmer: the encirclement on 8 November 1256, the Imam's surrender on 19 November, about eleven days in all, with three days of mangonel bombardment and a failed assault on the fourth, and some forty castles in the Rusbar valley opening in answer to the order of surrender. The garrison at Alamut was small, and its commander Mubariz capitulated in December 1256, though some sources date the formal surrender to January 1257; and because the Mongol reports of 1257 and 1258 reached the distant pope mixed with older news, the transmission of information lagged by months at the very least. Distance matters too: Alamut stands about six hundred kilometres from Baghdad, and when the Mongols rode south out of Khurasan in 1257 they relied on continuous mounted movement rather than a chain of fortified stages; by the spring of 1260 the total strength Hülegü claimed for the western army was still of the order of hundreds of thousands, a figure that by then could no longer be checked.
cause: 旭烈兀西征的起因不是單一事件，而是大汗蒙哥重新整理帝國西線的結果。蒙哥在 1251 年的怯綠連河大會上劃定各路將領的方向，旭烈兀所領的是最遠也最難的一段：花剌子模的餘部、波斯高原上的諸小邦、拒絕納貢的伊斯瑪儀派，以及仍在巴格達握有哈里發名號的阿拔斯朝廷。蒙古與這一地區並非素無往來：花剌子模之役後西方一度中止，1237 年蒙古軍再逼波斯時，伊斯瑪儀派曾一度歸附，蒙古在 1240 年代的文告中甚至許諾保護該派；但巴格達的哈里發朝廷同時把伊斯瑪儀派的首領拉入自己的軍政體系，讓其出任高位，兩邊的靠攏被蒙古視為對頭聯合，是對蒙古秩序的嚴重警號。1253 年旭烈兀在撒馬爾罕接見伊斯瑪儀派的使者，禮遇極隆，此時仍未打算大舉用兵；轉折點出現在 1255 年前後，蒙古使節在巴格達受阻，往來的文書與貢賦同時中斷，休戰破裂，旭烈兀隨即揮軍西進，把「先取哈里發、再取山中」的次序擺上桌面。
causeEn: Hülegü's expedition did not spring from a single incident but from Möngke's reorganisation of the empire's western front. At the kurultai of 1251 the Great Khan fixed the direction of every column, and Hülegü drew the longest and hardest share: the remnants of Khwarezm, the smaller states of the Iranian plateau, the Ismailis who refused to pay tribute, and the Abbasid court at Baghdad which still wore the caliphal title. The Mongols were not strangers to the region. After the Khwarezm war the westward drive had paused, and when the Mongol armies pressed into Persia again in 1237 the Ismailis submitted for a time, and the Mongol decrees of the 1240s even promised them protection. At the same time the caliphate in Baghdad drew the heads of the Ismailis into its own military and administrative system, granting them high office, and the Mongols read that rapprochement as the coming together of their adversaries and treated it as a serious warning against the new order. In 1253 Hülegü received the Ismaili envoys at Samarkand with great ceremony, and at that point he had no thought of a general war. The turning point came around 1255: the Mongol envoys were obstructed in Baghdad, the exchange of documents and of tribute stopped, the truce broke down, and Hülegü marched west, putting the order of operations on the table — first the caliph, then the mountains.
impact: 西征的直接後果，是兩個延續數百年的政治體系同時走到盡頭。1258 年 2 月哈里發穆斯台爾綏姆在巴格達被殺，阿拔斯王朝在巴格達的統治中斷，中東的哈里發權威自此只剩開羅那面由馬木魯克扶持的禮節性旗號；尼札里伊斯瑪儀派則在 1256 年 11 月至 12 月的一連串投降與拆城之後失去政權，成為分散各地的什葉派社區，其首領的「阿薩辛」稱號在歐洲與中東同時變成恐怖與背叛的代名詞，蒙古人在 1270 年代的法令和地圖上索性不再使用這個名目。更大範圍的影響落在地中海：1260 年 9 月艾因賈魯特之役，埃及與敘利亞的馬木魯克軍隊擊敗蒙古西征軍，旭烈兀放棄進攻埃及與歐洲的計畫，蒙古帝國的重心轉回東亞；蒙哥大汗 1259 年在釣魚城戰死，更迫使西征軍倉促回師，蒙古對歐洲的遠征計畫也停在半途。雙方往來留下的外交記錄同樣影響深遠：旭烈兀 1254 年與 1257 年兩度致書教宗英諾森四世與歐洲君主，蒙古與歐洲的接觸從此不再只是傳聞；而西征打通的草原通道又讓東西物產、造紙與火藥技術、伊斯蘭的天文曆算沿同一條路移動，後來蒙古諸國在伊朗建立的伊利汗國，其宮廷文化本身就脫胎於這段征服。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the expedition was that two political systems centuries old came to their end at the same time. In February 1258 the caliph al-Musta'sim was killed in Baghdad, Abbasid rule in Baghdad was broken, and the authority of the caliphate in the Middle East was reduced to the ceremonial flag raised in Cairo by the Mamluks. The Nizari Ismailis, after the series of surrenders and demolitions between November and December 1256, lost their state and became a Shi'i community scattered across the region, while the name of their leader, the Assassin, became in Europe and in the Middle East alike a synonym for terror and treachery, and the Mongols in the 1270s simply stopped using the term in their own decrees and maps. The wider effect fell on the Mediterranean: at Ain Jalut in September 1260 the Mamluk forces of Egypt and Syria beat the Mongol western army, Hülegü abandoned his plan against Egypt and Europe, and the centre of gravity of the empire swung back to East Asia; the death of Möngke at Diaoyu Fortress in 1259 forced the western army home in haste and left the Mongol plans for Europe unfinished in mid-course. The diplomatic record of these contacts mattered as well: Hülegü's letters of 1254 and 1257 to Pope Innocent IV and to European sovereigns meant that contact between Mongols and Europeans was no longer hearsay. And the steppe corridor opened by the campaign carried goods, the craft of papermaking and gunpowder, and the astronomy and calendrical science of Islam along one and the same road; the Ilkhanate the Mongols later founded in Iran took its own court culture directly from this conquest.
result: 1256 年 11 月 19 日的梅蒙迪茲投降，是這場西征在伊朗山區的轉折：末代伊瑪目庫爾沙走下山城，交出伊斯瑪儀派在魯斯巴河谷的城堡清單，約四十座堡壘陸續奉令開城，多數守軍在拆毀城防的同時散去；阿拉穆特由拜拉海大軍圍住，守將穆巴里茲以服從伊瑪目為由出降，蒙古人隨後拆毀城牆、焚毀屋舍，把那座建於山頂的要塞夷為平地。就此，尼札里伊斯瑪儀派作為一個國家從史冊上消失，旭烈兀的西征線再無北方山地的牽制。整條戰線繼續向西南推進：1257 年蒙古軍進入敘利亞，1258 年 2 月攻陷巴格達，哈里發被殺於城內；1259 年蒙哥大汗在釣魚城戰死的消息傳到前線，旭烈兀在敘利亞按兵未動；1260 年 9 月艾因賈魯特之役，怯的不花率中軍與拜都的右翼在埃及以東的平原被馬木魯克將軍貝巴爾斯與沙基夫所部擊破，怯的不花戰死，蒙古軍退入波斯，西進歐洲的門就此關上，而旭烈兀在伊朗建立的伊利汗國則站穩了腳步。這一場西征最終得手的，是從伊朗高原到兩河平原的一整片草原與城邑；最終沒能拿到的，是埃及與地中海。
resultEn: The surrender at Maymun-Diz on 19 November 1256 was the turning point of this expedition in the Iranian mountains: the last Imam Khurshah came down the slope, handed over the list of the Ismaili castles in the Rusbar valley, and some forty fortresses opened one after another on his command, most garrisons dispersing as their defences were dismantled; Alamut was invested by a large force under Balaghai, its commander Mubariz capitulated in obedience to the Imam, and the Mongols then pulled down the walls, burned the buildings and levelled a stronghold that had stood on the summit of its mountain. With that, the Nizari Ismailis disappeared from the roll of states, and nothing in the northern mountains held Hülegü's western line any longer. The whole front carried on to the south-west: the Mongol armies entered Syria in 1257 and took Baghdad in February 1258, the caliph killed inside the city; the news of the death of the Great Khan Möngke at Diaoyu Fortress in 1259 reached the front, and Hülegü stood still in Syria; and at Ain Jalut in September 1260 Kitbuqa's centre and Baidu's right wing were broken on the plain east of Egypt by the Mamluk forces of Baybars and Shirkuh, Kitbuqa was killed, the Mongols fell back into Persia, the door to Europe was shut for good, and the Ilkhanate Hülegü had founded in Iran stood firm. What this expedition finally won was the whole belt of steppe and city from the Iranian plateau to the Mesopotamian plain; what it never took was Egypt and the Mediterranean.
